scripts.setup-all: npm run setup && echo "Download Golang dependencies..." && go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest && go get ./...
scripts.upgrade-all: npx npm-check-updates -u && npm run setup && echo "Update Golang dependencies..." && go get -u ./...
scripts.build-all: swag init && npm run build && echo "Building Golang binary..." && CGO_ENABLED=1 go build
scripts.build-all-win: swag init && npm run build && echo "Building Golang binary..." && go build
scripts.docker-run: open-cli http://localhost:8080 && docker run -p 8080:8080 -v serve:/serve -v config:/config -v models:/models --rm xivi
scripts.commit: npm run format && go fmt ./... && git pull origin master && git add . && git commit -m "Updating" && git push origin master
